top_choice_rationale: P001 (Cullis, Hope, Madden) is the one proposal that combines a mechanism stated in physical terms (pKa-tuned ionizable headgroup, charge switch in the acidifying endosome, lipid polymorphism, rapid-mixing self-assembly kinetics) with full maturity (approved siRNA therapy, billions of mRNA vaccine doses, many independent groups) and a credit chain that fits within three names and can be defended by mechanism. The weakness is exclusion of Langer, Anderson and MacLachlan, and the citation must be about the lipid chemistry and not the 2023 Medicine vaccine work. P002 follows because the perovskite trio is well attributed but mechanism and stability are still contested; P005 and P004 are sound but each faces a precedent question (2010 and 1998 prizes); P003 is more genomics technology with parallel lineages left out; no award is last because a defensible chemistry prize exists.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, who does not support the top-ranked proposal, and a disclosed bias toward physically stated mechanisms
